name: Inclusive Manager — DEI in Daily Decisions
description: One week in the chair of Ana Torres-Mancebo, HRBP at the Norandic Iberia BU. Three concrete operational decisions land by Friday: facilitating a promotion calibration panel where the panel-favoured top-six is 5-1 male, holding a hiring-manager pushback conversation that does not over-reach into line-manager decision rights, and documenting three RTO accommodation cases across three different legal pathways. The simulation rewards fairness-by-design as craft: install the structure, do not legislate the outcome. Built on Bohnet, Edmondson, Roberson, Kalev-Dobbin-Kelly, Sue, and the Williams/McKinsey evidence base.

Wednesday · 10:00 · Calibration Panel

Round 1 — The Promotion Calibration Panel

Eighteen senior-engineer candidates, six promotion slots, four panellists plus you facilitating. The Sunday pre-read shows the panel-favoured top six is five men and one woman against a slate of ten men and eight women. Eduardo Castelar-Riera, the panel chair, pinged you Saturday: he does not want a quota conversation, but he does not want to sign a 5-1 list and find himself in the works-council the following week. The EU Pay Transparency Directive bites in June 2026; the Spanish Equality Plan target is 35% female on L1+L2 by end-2027. Install the protocol. Do not lecture the panel.

Framework anchors
Bohnet (structural-design move) · Edmondson (psychological safety) · Sue (pattern naming)
Tuesday · 11:00 · Iván's Office

Round 2 — Hiring Conversation with Iván Soares-Lourenço

Iván, BU Operations Director (L1), wants to sign Rodrigo Iñarritu-Salas — strongest on the traditional resume, weakest on the leadership-balance metric. Isabel Cañizares-Domínguez and Paula Restrepo-Hidalgo are credible alternatives; Paula was the only candidate with a unanimous would-actively-fight-to-hire from the loop. The hire takes the BU L1+L2 metric from 24% to 22% female. Iván is a senior operator, time-pressed, dismissive of moralistic framing. Forty-five minutes before he leaves for Setúbal. Install the structured re-evaluation framework. Do not veto the hire. Do not abdicate the role.

Framework anchors
Bohnet (structured interviewing) · Kalev-Dobbin-Kelly (what programs work) · McKinsey (held in reserve)
Friday · EOD · Three Memos to Sign

Round 3 — Three RTO Accommodation Decisions

Three escalations on your desk. Marta López-Cendán (single parent, Estatuto Article 37 family-care pathway). Diego Almazán-Pinilla (active ulcerative-colitis flare, IT plus reasonable-adjustment pathway). Núria Bertran-Alquézar (autistic, undocumented prior accommodation being unwound by a new manager, LGD reasonable-adjustment pathway). Three different legal pathways. Three different documentation formats. The works-council president Jordi Vilanova-Esquerda already has a heads-up. Friday end-of-day, the three decisions need to be signed and recorded. The CSRD S1 audit will reference the documentation discipline.

Framework anchors
Roberson (inclusion-climate move) · Spanish accommodation law · Estatuto Article 64 co-determination
